rationale: The original short thesis has degraded as AMBA reclaimed and closed above its 5-minute 9-EMA ($48.91), while the broader market is recovering from its lows (SPY improved from -1.24% to -1.01% and VIXY pulled back from +7.51% to +6.07%). Furthermore, the last five 1-minute candles show buyers stepping in at $48.83 and pushing price back to $49.26, leaving very unfavorable risk-to-reward right below the $49.40 invalidation level with a wide 60.9 bps spread. Initiating a close now allows the order to work passively near the $49.01 bid rather than risking a market cross at the top of a wide spread if $49.40 triggers.
